data.name: Calantha
data.gender_notes: Calantha is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Calantha is derived from the Greek word 'kalos,' meaning 'beautiful,' and 'anthos,' meaning 'flower.' This name signifies a woman who is as beautiful and radiant as a flower, and whose purity and holiness are a reflection of the divine. The name Calantha carries the meaning “Beautiful, pure, holy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Calantha usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, pure, holy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Calantha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
